rationale: Tests application of Asian-Indian BMI cut-offs — the most critical practical knowledge in this block on defining obesity in the Indian population
Tests understanding of metabolic syndrome as a complication in the natural history of obesity, and the central role of insulin resistance
Tests systematic physical examination skills in obesity — identifying specific examination findings that guide clinical reasoning about secondary causes and complications
Tests interpretation of investigation strategy — distinguishing routine screening tests from targeted tests for secondary causes
Tests pharmacotherapy decision-making including GLP-1 RA indications, agents, and the 5% minimum clinically meaningful weight-loss threshold
Tests understanding of Asian-Indian bariatric surgery indications which differ from Western thresholds
